- [Fintech LATAM](https://fintech.portfolio.the-full-stack.com/llms.txt):

- [Architect](https://architect.portfolio.the-full-stack.com/llms.txt):

- [Tech Lead](https://leader.portfolio.the-full-stack.com/llms.txt):
  team leadership, mentoring, shipping product.
- [Vibe Coding](https://vibe.portfolio.the-full-stack.com/llms.txt):

- [Posts](https://post.the-full-stack.com/llms.txt): practical guides
